settings.text:
Hey there! We’re Kristen and Trevor Ottaway, and together with our two daughters we call North Brisbane home.

Back in 2015 we were simply trying to solve a problem for our own family.

We cared deeply about the food we were eating and where it came from, but finding truly clean, nourishing food wasn’t easy. Our Saturdays were spent racing between farmers markets, organic stores and supermarkets just to piece together a week’s worth of groceries.

Then we met a local farmer friend, Kelly Strow, known as Farmer Kel. One day we asked her to put together a box of produce for us from the farms she worked with.

The quality was incredible. The food was fresh, seasonal and grown with care.

Our friends started asking if they could get boxes too, and before long we were packing produce into the back of our car and delivering them around Brisbane.

That small idea became Spray Free Farmacy.

What started as a simple produce box quickly grew into something much bigger.

More farmers joined us. More families discovered us. And a beautiful community began to form around a shared belief that food should nourish both people and the planet.

Over time our range expanded beyond fruit and vegetables to include pasture raised meat, dairy, pantry staples and wholefoods from local producers.

Today we work with an incredible network of farmers and food makers who share our values around soil health, animal welfare and growing food the right way.

Every week we now deliver fresh food to more than 500 families across South East Queensland.

And we still feed our own family the exact same food.

A New Chapter

After 10 years as Spray Free Farmacy, we realised our name no longer captured the full spirit of what we had become.

Our mission had grown beyond simply being spray free. It was about supporting farmers who care for their soil and animals. It was about nourishing families with real wholefoods.

And most of all, it was about the joy that comes from food grown well and shared with the people we love.

So in 2026 we became Joy Wholefoods.

A name that reflects what we’ve always believed: When food is grown with care, it brings joy to everyone involved farmers, families and the planet.

Our mission today is simple:

Support farmers who care for their soil.

Make real food easier for families to access.

Help people feel confident about what they’re feeding themselves and their children.

Because healthy soil grows healthier food. And healthy food helps people thrive.

settings.heading: Kristen's Story
settings.paragraph:
Behind Joy Wholefoods is a very personal journey.

For Kristen, this business began with a search for better health.

Like many people, she believed she was eating well. But she struggled with constant bloating, fatigue, digestive issues and relentless sugar cravings. Doctors told her diet wasn’t the problem and that medication was the only option.

But something didn’t feel right.

A book called No Impact Man by Colin Bevan opened her eyes to the hidden realities of modern food systems - pesticides, ultra processed ingredients, factory farming and the impact these have on both our health and the environment. This sparked years of research, documentaries and learning about food, soil and the way modern diets affect our bodies.

When Kristen shifted to a diet based on organic, whole foods, everything changed. Her energy returned. Her digestion improved. The cravings disappeared.

It was a powerful reminder that the food we eat truly matters.

This experience eventually led to Kristen creating a wellness community called Inspired Living Events, where people gathered to watch food documentaries, share organic meals and learn about healthy living.

One thing became clear again and again. People wanted access to real food grown by local farmers. But it wasn’t easy to find. And that realisation planted the seed for what would eventually become Spray Free Farmacy, and later, Joy Wholefoods.

settings.heading: Inspired Living Events
settings.paragraph:
I held monthly documentary screenings complete with organic meals and guest speakers. I added quarterly weekend retreats and a group membership for wellness entrepreneurs – it was an amazing three years and we brought together a beautiful community of like-minded people in Brisbane.

Something we all had in common was the desire to eat organic food, straight from local farmers. We wanted quality food, that was easy to access, without excess packaging, for a reasonable price.

I tried many local, organic delivery services, stores and co-ops, and went to all the markets, but they were either poor quality, ridiculously expensive, time-consuming (as in you had to go to a location and help sort the food) or inconvenient (ie. trying to make it to the markets before they sold out with a baby and a toddler!).

Then when my second daughter was just a couple of months old (2015), I was gifted a vision for Joy Wholefoods.

It was so clear what I needed to do and I got to work immediately – forming a partnership with Farmer Kel, we started delivering a few boxes of fresh, local spray-free produce each week to family and friends.

Kel had her own small farm near Woodford and was already collecting spray-free produce from neighbouring farms and selling it at local markets. Her produce was so fresh, tasty and such good value, that we were able to put together a really enticing offering for locals that was waste-free, easy and affordable.

We quickly established pick-up points so customers could collect from a location near them to avoid the cost of delivery, and we had a range of set boxes, eggs and a few add-ons to choose from (a super small selection to start with!).

From there, things grew rapidly. Our team expanded, delivery days increased, and many milestones were reached. When the first lockdown hit due to COVID-19, we were perfectly positioned to deliver to homes, and orders skyrocketed. Now, eight years into this incredible journey, we have an amazing team, a network of over 30 spray-free and certified organic farmers, and a family of loyal customers across South East Queensland.

We are incredibly grateful for the opportunity to share our love for organic, sustainable, and nourishing food with so many people every week. Knowing that we can make a positive impact on people's lives and the world around us fuels our passion and keeps us excited for what the future holds.

We invite you to join our Joy Family and try out one of our boxes this week. We just know you’re going to love it!

settings.text:
Today we feel incredibly grateful to work with farmers who grow beautiful food and to serve a community that cares deeply about what they eat.

We’d love for you to be part of it.
